objective: Passively record raw pre-sampling DFlash top-32 distributions for the accepted n_max=12 configuration and replay pinned DDTree policies host-only.

configuration.prompt: Explain why deterministic validation matters when optimizing GPU inference kernels. Be concise and technically precise.

recorder.activation: APEX_DFLASH_RECORDER_FILE only; absent means byte-identical runtime behavior
recorder.source_tap: raw llama_get_logits_ith DFlash noise positions before common_sampler_sample
recorder.normalization: full-vocabulary log-sum-exp; emitted finite F32 log probabilities
required_per_cycle: feature gather, encode, injection, draft decode and export timings
recorder.canonical_join: join cycle roots and drafted prefixes to exact returned target token IDs; record canonical token/rank, accepted length and committed tokens; terminal horizon rows may be marked unavailable but never fabricated

parity_gates.baseline_vs_recorder: two independent normal-graph 192-token requests, exact token IDs and content
parity_gates.distribution: every replayed cycle has exactly 12 rows and 32 finite, unique, descending entries; logsumexp metadata finite; cycle IDs strictly increasing
parity_gates.placement: target remains tensor split; draft remains layer split; both GPUs; no OOM; zero target VRAM after exit
parity_gates.source: no target HIP, Q6 arithmetic, P2P, all-reduce, graph, sampling-chain or draft-token selection change

ddtree.execution: host-only deterministic replay; no import of CUDA-dependent module

decision: Any parity or recorder integrity failure closes complete_no_go. A useful replay result authorizes only a separately frozen parent-aware correctness phase.
